name: blockvectra
description: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP for developers and AI agents. Documentation, chain discovery, pricing and chain-permitted public JSON-RPC are available without a key; Data API and account tools require an API key. A free plan is available with metered usage beyond its limits. The server can broadcast signed transactions through send_raw_transaction.

streamable-http.description: Remote endpoint; no key is needed for docs, chain discovery, pricing or permitted public RPC. Configure x-api-key for Data API and account tools.

BLOCKVECTRA_API_KEY.description: Optional for connecting; required for Data API and account tools, and for RPC methods outside a chain public policy.
